product_overview: Split Fun PRO is a Cloudflare-hosted service for managing shared expenses, group balances, settlements and gamified payment reminders. It provides email/password authentication, group and expense management, payment reminders with memes stored in R2, and an achievements system.
core_goals: Enable fast and accurate tracking of shared expenses and simplified netted balances
Provide low-friction ways to request and record payments (reminders, settlements)
Support registered and unregistered group members and simple invitation flows
Encourage user engagement with gamification (achievements) and reminders
Operate fully on Cloudflare stack (Workers, D1, R2) with secure authentication and session handling

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email/password registration, login/logout, email verification and password reset with secure sessions and single-use tokens.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with body {email, password} -> Receive 200 {success: true, message: string} (sends verification email token)
POST /api/auth/verify-email with body {token} -> Receive 200 {success: true}
POST /api/auth/login with body {email, password} -> Receive 200 {success: true} and Set-Cookie HTTP-only session cookie (60 days)
POST /api/auth/logout with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true} and session removed from DB
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with body {email} -> Receive 200 {success: true, message: string} (does not reveal existence of email)
POST /api/auth/reset-password with body {token, password} -> Receive 200 {success: true} and invalidate all active sessions
POST /api/auth/register with body {email, password} when EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY missing or invalid -> Receive 500 {error: string, message: string}

features.name: User Profile
features.description: View and edit the authenticated user's basic info and searchable friend code.
user_flows: GET /api/users/me with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {id: string, email: string}
GET /api/users/me without session cookie -> Receive 401 {error: Unauthorized}
GET /api/users/search?q={q} with HTTP-only session cookie (q >= 3 chars) -> Receive 200 {results: [{id, display_name, friend_code}]}
GET /api/users/search?q={q} with HTTP-only session cookie and q < 3 -> Receive 400 {error: string}
GET /api/profile with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {display_name: string, friend_code: string}
PATCH /api/profile with HTTP-only session cookie and body {display_name} -> Receive 200 {success: true}

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Aggregated view of groups, recent expenses, and consolidated owed/owing totals for the authenticated user.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {groups: Group[], recentExpenses: Expense[], totalOwed: number, totalOwing: number}
GET /api/my-debts with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {debts: [{groupId, groupName, from, to, amount}]}
GET /api/dashboard without session cookie -> Receive 401 {error: Unauthorized}

features.name: Groups
features.description: Create, list, view, update and delete expense-sharing groups and retrieve simplified member balances.
user_flows: GET /api/groups with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 Group[] (lists groups current user belongs to)
POST /api/groups with HTTP-only session cookie and body {name, emoji, description} -> Receive 200 Group (new group created)
POST /api/groups with invalid body -> Receive 400 {error: string}
GET /api/groups/:id with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 Group (members, expenses, settlements)
GET /api/groups/:id with HTTP-only session cookie when user not member -> Receive 403 {error: Forbidden}
PATCH /api/groups/:id with HTTP-only session cookie and body {name, emoji, description} -> Receive 200 {success: true}
DELETE /api/groups/:id with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true} (cascade deletes group data)
GET /api/groups/:id/balances with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {balances: [{from, to, amount}]}

features.name: Group Members
features.description: Add or remove members from a group by friend code or email; supports inviting unregistered users.
user_flows: POST /api/groups/:id/members with HTTP-only session cookie and body {friend_code, email, display_name} -> Receive 200 {success: true} (adds registered or unregistered member)
POST /api/groups/:id/members with HTTP-only session cookie and body referencing unknown friend_code/email -> Receive 404 {error: User Not Found}
DELETE /api/groups/:id/members/:memberId with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true} (member removed)
DELETE /api/groups/:id/members/:memberId with HTTP-only session cookie when caller lacks permission -> Receive 403 {error: Forbidden}

features.name: Expenses
features.description: Create and manage shared expenses with equal or percentage splits, list expenses across groups or per group, and delete expenses.
user_flows: GET /api/expenses with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 Expense[] (all user expenses across groups)
POST /api/expenses with HTTP-only session cookie and body {group_id, description, amount, paid_by, date, splits} -> Receive 200 Expense (expense created and splits recorded)
POST /api/expenses with HTTP-only session cookie and invalid splits/amount -> Receive 400 {error: string}
GET /api/groups/:id/expenses with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 Expense[] (group expenses)
DELETE /api/expenses/:id with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true}
DELETE /api/expenses/:id with HTTP-only session cookie when not authorized -> Receive 403 {error: Forbidden}

features.name: Settlements
features.description: Record and list payments (settlements) between group members to clear debts.
user_flows: POST /api/settlements with HTTP-only session cookie and body {group_id, from_member_id, to_member_id, amount, note} -> Receive 200 {success: true, id: string} (settlement recorded)
POST /api/settlements with HTTP-only session cookie and invalid amount or missing members -> Receive 400 {error: string}
GET /api/groups/:id/settlements with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 Settlement[] (group settlement history)

features.name: Payment Reminders (Don Barriga)
features.description: Send gamified payment reminders (message + meme stored in R2), list received reminders, get unseen counts, and mark reminders as seen.
user_flows: POST /api/payment-reminders with HTTP-only session cookie and body {to_member_id, group_id, message, meme_key} -> Receive 200 {success: true, id: string} (sends reminder and stores meme reference)
POST /api/payment-reminders with HTTP-only session cookie and missing/invalid meme_key -> Receive 400 {error: string}
GET /api/payment-reminders with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 PaymentReminder[] (reminders received by user)
GET /api/payment-reminders/count with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {count: number} (badge count of unseen reminders)
PATCH /api/payment-reminders/:id/seen with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {success: true}
PATCH /api/payment-reminders/:id/seen with HTTP-only session cookie for non-existent id -> Receive 404 {error: Not Found}

features.name: Achievements
features.description: Track and unlock user achievements based on actions (group creation, settlements, etc.).
user_flows: GET /api/achievements with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {achievements: [{key: string, unlocked_at: string}]}
POST /api/achievements/check with HTTP-only session cookie -> Receive 200 {newly_unlocked: string[]} (checks and unlocks newly achieved badges)
